author: _Stormz
body:
I want to raise the concern regarding permission abuse on TS. 

http://imgur.com/gUUFGTd

People just come in and out of team channels without permission. A team channel is a team channel for a reason. It's supposed to be private. It's not a public bath. I'm hoping you guys will change the rules of TS team rooms and permissions of those who can join any team channel as well.
